### Diebold Nixdorf Board of Directors Authorizes New $250 Million Share Repurchase Program


October 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s27.q4cdn.com/808990265/files/doc_news/Diebold-Nixdorf-Board-of-Directors-Authorizes-New-250-Million-Share-Repurchase-Program-2026.pdf)


*Previous $200 million repurchase program is nearly complete*


NORTH CANTON, Ohio


, Oct. 28, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD), a global leader in transforming the way people bank and shop, today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new share repurchase program whereby the company may repurchase up to $250 million shares of its common stock. The previous $200 million share repurchase program, announced on Nov. 5, 2025, is nearly complete.


**Tom Timko, executive vice president and chief financial officer, said:** "As we reach the completion of our previous $200 million share repurchase program, we continue our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and delivering long-term value to stockholders. The new $250 million program provides additional flexibility to return capital while continuing to invest in and capitalize on strategic opportunities across our businesses."


**Additional Repurchase Plan Details** The company may utilize a number of different methods to effect the repurchases, including open market purchases, which may include, without limitation, round lot or block transactions, including through one or more accelerated stock repurchase plans or pursuant to the terms of one or more repurchase plans in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The specific timing, price and size of any purchases will depend on prevailing stock prices, general market and economic conditions, and other considerations. The share repurchase program may be extended, suspended, or discontinued at any time without prior notice and does not obligate us to acquire any particular amount of common stock.


NOTE TO READERS – Please see *"Diebold Nixdorf Reports Third Quarter Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Growth,"* also released today, for more information.


**About Diebold Nixdorf** Diebold Nixdorf, Incorporated (NYSE: DBD) automates, digitizes and transforms the way people bank and shop. As a partner to the majority of the world's top 100 financial institutions and top 25 global retailers, our integrated solutions connect digital and physical channels conveniently, securely and efficiently for millions of consumers each day. The company has a presence in more than 100 countries with approximately 20,000 employees worldwide.
